articles.title: Letters: Thistle Lane Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Thistle Lane for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made.
Please keep the winter coat drive in the budget. Many of us on Thistle Lane use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Eleanor Sokolov, Canal Park

articles.title: Agnes Garrity, 82, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Agnes Garrity for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Agnes Garrity spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Agnes Garrity died in January at home on Tannery Street, at the age of 82.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Bellwood Chapel in his or her name. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats.

articles.title: Foxglove Heights Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: The vote came after 35 residents spoke at Monday’s session.
body: Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. Residents of Foxglove Heights said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.

Public works estimates the work will take about 35 weeks once it starts in January. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.
Councilmember Hannah Rooney asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $12,000.
